text.tspan: 授权核验与恢复作业

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif;
text.tspan: RabbitMQ

text.tspan: 外部支付适配器

text.tspan: S-06 payment-service

text.tspan: S-04 pricing-service

text.tspan: S-02 ride-service

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 实线请求 / 虚线响应 / 开放箭头异步事实

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 以下为互相独立的恢复场景，不是一个尝试必须经过的顺序

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 场景 A：完成时计量未齐；费用待确定

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 核验来源/结束时间/归属，只补首份完整计量

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 冻结 measurement + Outbox；冲突转人工，不能改已有 Bill

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 同一 Job 恢复；补齐先到也不能忽略

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 唯一 Bill + READY + Outbox，重复事件不重复出账

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 持久 Job 后推进游标；已完成 Job/Bill 不重复建立

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [长时间漏消息的补漏作业]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 场景 B：创建支付响应丢失或渠道结果未知

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [已提交创建]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

g.text: [未观察到原操作 / 仍在处理]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 原发送任务与 channelRequestId 持久保存

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 崩溃恢复不换号；不因超时释放 billId 未决槽位

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 退避后查原请求；预算耗尽持久隔离/对账

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 仍保持未决，不能变成 FAILED_FINAL 或再次扣款

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Receipt 和 SUCCEEDED 同事务；查询与回调共用唯一约束

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [超时 / 普通 NOT_FOUND / 仍处理中]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 场景 C：渠道明确不可逆失败，用户重新确认

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 核验身份/商户/请求号/金额/币种/终态证据

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 仅不可逆失败可置 FAILED_FINAL + 释放槽位，同事务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 本人确认的新意图；事务内重新检查已付/未决/审计冻结

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 不是自动换键重试旧的未知付款

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 场景 D：重复、伪造、乱序及矛盾回调

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 迟到失败不能覆盖 Receipt/SUCCEEDED

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
